arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-1/workspace/task; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[]; invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    raw=f.read().decode('utf-8')
for i,line in enumerate(raw.split('\n'),1):
    if line.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error' and 'code' in obj:
        codes.append(obj['code'])
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'codes':codes,'invalid_lines':invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat scratch/errors.json; echo ---; md5 scratch/log.jsonl
